sources.label: Predictive design of tissue-specific mammalian enhancers that function in the mouse embryo — Nature Genetics, August 25, 2026; published research

research.summary: As the moonship passes, a sleeping landscape begins to glow from within. Inspired by synthetic enhancer design: all 15 designed DNA sequences drove reporter expression in their intended mouse embryonic tissues—heart, limb or central nervous system—with some activity outside the target tissue.
